description: Play the classic 2048 puzzle game right in ChatGPT! Use arrow keys or swipe to slide numbered tiles on a grid. When two tiles with the same number collide, they merge into one with double the value. Combine tiles strategically to reach the brag-worthy 2048 tile. Features smooth animations, modern UI, score tracking, and best score. Perfect for a quick brain-teasing break!
